verdict.rationale: Mercury's own docs describe a built-in assistant, Mercury Command, that accepts plain-language requests and can be handed bookkeeping tasks directly. Named tasks include writing journal entries, organizing the chart of accounts, bulk categorization, bulk GL-code assignment and creating categorization rules. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed, and in-depth documentation of how delegated actions are reviewed, approved or limited (beyond marketing copy).
